scope: The existing finite Bool spectral witness, not all carriers or physical sectors.

domains.native: Four source labels with retained path/schedule records.
domains.linear_action: Declared free C4 linearization; algebra generated by I, P_L, P_R.
domains.continuous_control: Declared independent coefficients of the two commuting pi-scaled generators; physical rate/control authorization is not supplied.
domains.observation: Declared Hermitian 4x4 state model with mathematical trace pairing and coordinate projectors propagated by the same local spectral flows. This is not a derivation or physical authorization of Born measurements.

predeclared_basis.operators: All sixteen tensor Pauli matrices from I,X,Y,Z on each factor.
predeclared_basis.propagated_readouts: Conjugates of the coordinate projectors by U_R(b)U_L(a), with the existing spectral rule.
predeclared_basis.finite_spanning_settings: a,b in {0,1/2}; the all-time upper bound must be proved separately from the rotation formula.

gate_questions: Do source labels admit a sector splitting in the declared linearization?
What native action algebra and continuous-control Lie algebra are available, without promoting discrete reachability to arbitrary state control?
Do the native or propagated mathematical readouts distinguish the expanded Hermitian state domain?
Which exact finite lower bounds hold on the observable subspace, and which directions have zero bound?

normalization.record_coordinates: trace(E rho) for each complete mathematical coordinate-projector measurement
normalization.energy_and_time: Use existing pi/angle and quadratic-energy conventions; no physical units introduced.

hostile_requirements: Supply distinct positive trace-one Hermitian states with equal propagated records if full observability fails.
Retain source/schedule records separately; scalar record equality is not full-record equality.
Do not add an X observer or an entangling control without independent source/instrument authorization.
